constitution.title: Body Type Reference
constitution.intro: A reference to help identify the basic body type.

light.title: Light build
light.desc: Slim, fine-boned. Fast metabolism. Finds it hard to gain weight.

medium.title: Medium build
medium.desc: Athletic, sturdy build. Well-defined muscles. Weight adjusts easily.

heavy.title: Heavy build
heavy.desc: Solid, heavy build. Slow metabolism. Tends to put on weight.

bedi.title: Understanding BEDI
bedi.intro: The deviation (Δ) shows the current state of your balance.

body.khii_excess: Khii is dominant. Warm meals and a restful routine are needed.
body.balanced: Khii, Shar and Badgan are in balance. Keep your current routine.
body.shar_badgan_excess: Shar/Badgan is dominant. Light meals and cooling exercise.

intro.title: The Three Constitutions
intro.text: Your body is a combination of the three constitutions. The assessment determines their proportions.

S.label: Shar (Fire)
S.body: Fire + water. Sharp mind, a leader, decisive.

B.label: Badgan (Earth)
B.body: Earth + water. Patient, steady, caring nature.

info.title: Why Is This Needed?
info.intro: This information is used to calculate the BEDI index accurately.

heightWeight.label: Height & weight
heightWeight.body: Weight and height enter the BEDI formula directly.

age.label: Age
age.body: The age coefficient affects the biological baseline.

sex.label: Sex
sex.body: Biological sex sets the physiological baseline.

questions.hint: Answer from your innate nature — how you have always been, not how you are today.

kt.title: Kt Coefficient
kt.intro: Kt is the baseline of your constitutional balance and is used in the BEDI calculation.

low.label: Kt < 1.0 · Khii dominant
low.body: Khii predominates. People with a light, flexible build.

balanced.label: Kt ≈ 1.0 · Balanced
balanced.body: Khii, Shar and Badgan are in balance. Close to spring and autumn.

high.label: Kt > 1.0 · Shar/Badgan
high.body: Shar/Badgan predominates. A heavy, steady build.
